test.title: A place you would visit again

document.cue: Describe a place you visited that you would like to go back to.

text: The place I'd love to go back to is Charyn Canyon, which is in the south-east of Kazakhstan, about two hundred kilometres from Almaty. I went there two summers ago with a group of friends, and we hired a car and drove for roughly four hours. It took us a while to find the right road, but it was part of the adventure.

When we arrived, we were stunned by the scenery. The canyon is full of enormous red rocks that have been shaped by wind and water over millions of years, and in the evening sunlight they almost seem to glow. We spent most of the day hiking down to the river at the bottom, taking photos and having a picnic under the trees. We also camped nearby that night, and the sky was so clear that we could see thousands of stars, which you can never see in the city. The air was hot and dry during the day, but it became pleasantly cool in the evening.

I'd like to return because we were in a rush and didn't manage to explore the whole area. There are several other valleys that we missed, and I'd also like to visit in autumn, when the colours are supposed to be even more beautiful. Besides that, the trip made me realise that I don't need to go abroad to see amazing places, as there's so much to discover in my own country. So I'm planning to go back next year, perhaps with my family this time.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: The place I'd love to go back to is Charyn Canyon

tips.en: Descriptive language with a passive creates a picture and shows grammatical range.
tips.kk: Ырықсыз етісті бейнелі сипаттау көрініс жасап, бай грамматиканы көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Образное описание с пассивом создаёт картинку и показывает богатую грамматику.
tips.example: enormous red rocks that have been shaped by wind and water over millions of years

tips.en: The reason for returning is stated concretely and honestly.
tips.kk: Қайта оралу себебі нақты әрі адал айтылған.
tips.ru: Причина возвращения даётся конкретно и честно.
tips.example: I'd like to return because we were in a rush and didn't manage to explore the whole area

note.en: Introduction: where the place is and when you went.
note.kk: Кіріспе: орын қайда орналасқан және қашан болдыңыз.
note.ru: Вступление: где находится место и когда вы там были.

note.en: Body: what you did there, with landscape and activities.
note.kk: Негізгі бөлім: онда не істедіңіз — табиғат пен әрекеттердің сипаттамасы.
note.ru: Основная часть: что вы там делали — описание пейзажа и занятий.

note.en: Conclusion: why you want to return and a plan for the future.
note.kk: Қорытынды: неге қайта оралғыңыз келеді және болашақ жоспар.
note.ru: Заключение: почему хотите вернуться, и планы на будущее.
